## Change

What problem does this address, and what now happens?

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Note anything not tested.

## Scientific or user-facing impact

State any changes to provenance, assumptions, curated/provisional status, safety boundaries, or uncertainty. Use “none” when appropriate.

- [ ] Tests protect the intended behavior without weakening scientific expectations.
- [ ] Citations, fixtures, and reported results are real or explicitly synthetic.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, local artifacts, or unsupported claims are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and limitations are updated.
